clue.text: Unpleasant person Liberal exposed

parts.note: something exposed is out in the open, as a secret that is out

explanation.surface: A Liberal politician is revealed to be a nasty piece of work.
explanation.definitionFit: A boorish, aggressive man is a classic example of an unpleasant person.

clue.text: Dangerous area of wood, English, elevated part

parts.note: fir is a kind of tree and its timber

indicators.note: in a down clue, raising a word means reading it upwards, so backwards

explanation.surface: Describes a risky woodland zone with a raised English section.
explanation.walkthrough: 'elevated' turns PART upside down in the down entry, giving TRAP.
explanation.definitionFit: A building likely to catch fire with no easy escape is a hazardous place to be.

clue.text: Instrument initially very intimidating, one loves it now

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of each of the words that follow

explanation.surface: An instrument that was once very daunting is now loved by someone.
explanation.definitionFit: The fiddle is a stringed musical instrument played with a bow.

clue.text: Attacks engulfing quiet area of running water

indicators.note: engulfing means the first piece swallows the second

parts.note: raids are sudden attacks
p (piano) is the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: Attacks overwhelming a tranquil stretch of river.
explanation.definitionFit: A stretch of river where the current runs fast over rocks is a water hazard for boats.

clue.text: Band's assistant or aide, put another way?

indicators.note: putting the words another way means rearranging their letters

explanation.surface: Asks whether a band's helper is simply an aide by another name.
explanation.definitionFit: Touring musicians rely on crew members who set up and carry their equipment.

clue.text: Starter of prawns as alternative to king's meat

indicators.note: starter of means the first letter of the following word

parts.note: or is the word that offers an alternative
K is the chess and card abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A prawn starter offered instead of the king's meat course.
explanation.definitionFit: Flesh of the pig is eaten as a common type of meat.

clue.text: Referring to trendy wear of French person giving autograph?

parts.note: de is French for of
someone signing an autograph is a signer

explanation.surface: Asks whether a fashion-related French celebrity is signing autographs.
explanation.definitionFit: Labels by famous fashion houses are what make clothes fashionable and expensive, as in label clothing.

clue.text: Copilot I misrepresented as MP perhaps

indicators.note: misrepresented says the letters are presented in a wrong order

explanation.surface: An airline copilot complains of being misrepresented as a Member of Parliament.
explanation.definitionFit: A Member of Parliament is an example of a politically active person, an informal term.

clue.text: Once more afforded Soho? Odd places only

indicators.note: only the letters in odd-numbered positions are kept, the first, third, fifth and so on

explanation.surface: Asks whether Soho, the London entertainment district, was again affordable.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something anew, from the start again, means doing it once more.

clue.text: Costing a lot, went ahead — like some churches?

parts.note: steep prices are high
to lead is to go ahead of others

explanation.surface: Something expensive went ahead, perhaps a church restoration project.
explanation.definitionFit: Many churches have a tall pointed spire tower, which this adjective describes.

clue.text: God's tough order — each disheartened

indicators.note: each word loses its heart, keeping only its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A deity issues a harsh command.
explanation.definitionFit: The Norse thunder deity carried a hammer called Mjolnir.

clue.text: Daughter left home taken in by fast mover, uncompromising

indicators.note: taken in by means these pieces go inside the next one

parts.note: a hare is a famously fast animal
to be in is to be at home

explanation.surface: A daughter leaving home is caught by something speedy and unyielding.
explanation.definitionFit: A rigid, unbending stance that refuses concessions is described with this adjective.

clue.text: Requiring 50 to be accommodated? Annoying

indicators.note: accommodated means housed inside the other word

parts.note: needing means requiring
L is the Roman numeral for 50

explanation.surface: Someone needing fifty beds for guests finds it irritating.
explanation.definitionFit: Persistently teasing or provoking someone is irritating behaviour.

clue.text: Woman from Nevada

indicators.note: from says the letters are taken out of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A lady hailing from the US state of Nevada.
explanation.definitionFit: A common female first name, so an example of a woman.

clue.text: Settled European artist extremely rarely interested in writing

parts.note: a bird that has lit on a branch has settled there
RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword artist

indicators.note: extremely means take the extreme letters, first and last

explanation.surface: A European artist who settled somewhere rarely cared about writing.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone bookish who loves literature and authors has this adjective applied to them.

clue.text: Very hot and of current interest (about right)

indicators.note: about means the first word goes round the second

parts.note: topical matters are of current interest

explanation.surface: Something both sweltering and newsworthy, with a parenthetical aside.
explanation.definitionFit: Climates near the equator are hot and humid all year round.

clue.text: I must leave Riviera resort after tea break

indicators.note: after puts the shortened resort behind the tea

parts.note: cha is slang for tea

indicators.note: must leave says the letter is removed

parts.note: Nice is a resort on the French Riviera

explanation.surface: A holidaymaker must depart the Riviera after a tea break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'must leave' removes I from NICE, leaving NCE.
explanation.definitionFit: A lucky break is an opportunity or fortunate opening.

clue.text: Part of shibboleth — a little deadly

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A shibboleth used in small doses can still kill.
explanation.definitionFit: Something capable of causing death is fatal, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Feature of car in Middle East port

definitions.meaning: the rubber ring round each wheel
an ancient port city in Lebanon

explanation.surface: A car part spotted in a Middle Eastern harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Every car wheel has a rubber covering, and the Lebanese city of that name is an old seaport.

clue.text: Thin person's desire to get parking for husband

indicators.note: to get says something new is brought in
for says the new letter replaces the old one

parts.note: a wish is a desire
P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

explanation.surface: A slim person wants a parking space instead of a husband.
explanation.definitionFit: A slight, slender figure is described as a slip or wisp of a thing.

clue.text: Star skater is spoilt

indicators.note: spoilt means the letters are ruined and reordered

explanation.surface: A star figure skater has been pampered.
explanation.definitionFit: The star-shaped printed symbol used to flag a footnote.

clue.text: Pulls up studious guy

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to tow is to pull

explanation.surface: A bookish fellow pulls his socks up.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang for a pupil who studies hard, a bookworm.

clue.text: One of great strength protecting island painter

indicators.note: protecting means wrapping round the other piece

parts.note: a titan is a giant of great power

explanation.surface: A strongman guarding an island artist.
explanation.definitionFit: The Venetian Renaissance master Tiziano Vecellio is known in English by this name.

clue.text: Macro, tho complicated, can be discussed here?

indicators.note: complicated means the letters are tangled into a new order

explanation.surface: A computer macro, though tricky, can be talked about here.
explanation.definitionFit: An online forum for live text conversation is a place where things get talked about.

clue.text: Tiny pastry? It could make you cry!

parts.note: wee is Scottish for tiny
a pie is a pastry dish

explanation.surface: A miniature pie is so sad it brings tears.
explanation.definitionFit: A sentimental film or book designed to make the audience weep.
